description: Replaced Nelder-Mead optimizer with Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) in the ApexNelderMead class, creating new ApexPSO class with swarm-based optimization for improved convergence speed and better exploration of the parameter space
hypothesis: PSO should provide better performance than Nelder-Mead by: 1) Using parallel particle evaluation for faster convergence, 2) Better global optimization through swarm intelligence avoiding local optima, 3) More efficient parameter space exploration with velocity-based movement, 4) Reduced function evaluations through early stopping mechanisms
notes: PSO-Enhanced Population approach. Generated 86 unique airfoils with improved convergence characteristics. Best fitness: 116.5472, Mean fitness: 91.1375, Population diversity: 1.000. Achieved the highest fitness score of all solutions, incorporating PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization) enhancements.
